# Stackivo

> Stackivo is an all-in-one client-workflow workspace for Indian freelancers,
> consultants, and small studios. It replaces the scattered stack of Excel
> invoices, WhatsApp follow-ups, Word contracts, and notes-app time tracking
> with one fast web app: clients (CRM), GST-ready invoicing, contracts with
> e-signature, welcome/onboarding documents, projects, time tracking, a
> branded client portal, payments via Razorpay (UPI / cards / netbanking),
> Pulse analytics, and an in-app AI assistant.

Key facts:
- Audience: Indian freelancers, independent consultants, and small studios.
- Pricing: Free plan covers the first 5 clients (free forever, no card).
  Pro is ₹499/month and Business ₹1,499/month; annual billing gives about
  two months free. 30-day money-back guarantee on paid plans.
- GST: invoices can be simple (non-GST) or full GST; CGST/SGST vs IGST is
  applied automatically from the client's state.
- Payments: Razorpay checkout — UPI, cards, netbanking; payments reconcile
  to invoices automatically.
- Data: workspaces are isolated with row-level security; daily backups;
  data is exportable. Governed by India's DPDP Act, 2023.
- Independently operated from Indore, India.
